findings.text: follow-on: the module re-declares EXCITATION_CURRENT=1e3, PLASMA_FREE_CURRENT=5e3 and MINIMUM_PROBES, and re-implements the vacuum-cohort admission predicate (census_shot/admits) and a store enumeration (store_shots at :108), which nova/imas/mast_vacuum_cohort.py already owns at lines 263, 274, 597 and select_vacuum_cohort:718. Section 5 of the owning plan says to extend the owners rather than adding a parallel path, and the owner already exposes a store reader, so the light-census admission lacks the seam it should live behind; the values agree today and will silently diverge if the owner's criteria change.

follow-on: the sole control is a deliberately misspelled channel name (sad_out_zz99), which reports unreachable over the cohort because no shot carries it; it cannot falsify the family-specific key-width defect the prior review found, because it never touches the m-family spelling. No test or assertion guards the resolve-from-keys behaviour, so a future one-width assumption would regress unobserved.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to record whether an uncorrected MAST saddle-loop voltage is reachable for the vacuum cohort; benchmarks/mast_saddle_voltage_reach.py probes the level-1 xmb group per loop and writes docs/figures/mast-saddle-loops/reach.json, which now reports 36 of 36 loops reachable through xmb/sad_out_<family><index> with each loop's raw key resolved from the store's own key set.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names the benchmark, the receipt, the fragment, two exit-0 job logs and the misspelled-channel control, and its account matches the receipt and the log, including the corrected 36/36 headline.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's declared roots are benchmarks/mast_saddle_voltage_reach.py, docs/figures/mast-saddle-loops and docs/evidence/fragments/mast-nonaxisymmetric-physics/mast-saddle-voltage-reach.html; git diff --name-status f2bac518e c173d3991 is exactly those three added paths.

justifications.durability: no test references benchmarks/mast_saddle_voltage_reach.py; the only control is MISSPELLED_CHANNEL at benchmarks/mast_saddle_voltage_reach.py:57, a random name that cannot falsify the three-digit m-family spelling, so a width regression is now guarded by the resolve-from-keys approach but by no assertion that would redden.
justifications.evidence: docs/figures/mast-saddle-loops/reach.json is a traceable receipt over the level-1 store with per-loop raw_key_resolved spellings and a negative-control row, and the fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/mast-nonaxisymmetric-physics/mast-saddle-voltage-reach.html now reproduces it exactly; the comparisons section carries six shots but the fragment narrates only shot 14811, so the six-shot RMS range the manifest cites is not shown in the prose.
justifications.fit: the retired-registry import is gone and the module reads saddle geometry from the magnetics IDS as the plan directs, but it re-declares the cohort criteria constants at benchmarks/mast_saddle_voltage_reach.py:52-54 that its owner already defines.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/mast_saddle_voltage_reach.py:203 resolves each loop's raw key from the store's own key set and the receipt reports 36/36 reachable, correcting the m_10..m_12 false negative the prior review recorded at this node's first head.
justifications.reuse: benchmarks/mast_saddle_voltage_reach.py:108 store_shots and the census_shot/admits admission predicate at :129-191 re-implement nova/imas/mast_vacuum_cohort.py:597 store_shots and select_vacuum_cohort, and the criteria constants at :52-54 duplicate mast_vacuum_cohort.py:263,274, without extending that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status f2bac518e c173d3991 lists exactly the three declared added paths and nothing under nova/ or tests/.

notes: Independent review of r-20261008T015056150935-mast-saddle-voltage-reach at head c173d3991e82167cc72bd06a8591ed0862e411c0 against base f2bac518e47057cec01dd505c6dbbba7c8892b3c. The node answers section 5's first deliverable -- whether an uncorrected saddle-loop voltage, pickup retained, is reachable for the vacuum cohort -- by probing the level-1 XMB group per loop over an 86-shot even-strided cohort (26 carry xmb, 60 do not) and writing a per-loop receipt. All three findings the prior review recorded at head 9eb100e5e are repaired and independently confirmed fixed: the m_10..m_12 zero-padding false negative is gone, reach now being 36/36 with each loop's raw key resolved from the store's own key set, and the store confirm the three-digit names sad_out_m010, sad_out_m011 and sad_out_m012 present on the same 26 cohort shots as sad_out_m09 while sad_out_m10/m11/m12 are absent and the l and u families stay two-digit; the fragment now reproduces the receipt, carrying a per-loop coverage table that matches reach.json and stating that 60 of the 86 admitted shots carry no xmb group, which resolves the prior second finding; and the retired-catalog MachineGeometryRegistry import is deleted, grep finding no MachineGeometryRegistry or catalog.mast_geometry reference, with the coil kernel recorded unavailable and its reason stated. Two follow-on observations remain, neither blocking. No fit was run and no sign was promoted, which is what this node -- section 5's first of four -- is scoped to answer.
